about: The harness's steps, written once. The process page (process_page.py) and the process figures (figures.py) are both drawn from this file. who: us (the researchers), model, or program (ordinary code that gives the same output for the same input). check: a point where we decide. status: built, or being rebuilt for codebook version 1.0.

us.name: Us
us.why: Research decisions: what to ask, what to read, what enters the codebook, what the findings mean.

model.name: Model
model.why: Reading for meaning at a scale people cannot. Every output is checked by the program and decided by us.

program.name: Program
program.why: Work that must come out the same every time: splitting, numbering, copying, checking, counting, applying rules. Free, instant, and anyone can rerun it.

phases.name: Build the codebook
phases.containers: The papers fill the groups with codes. A program checks the model's work after each model step.
phases.out: Codebook version 1.0 and the codebook trail

steps.what: Set the question and groups; choose the papers
steps.record: The Stage 1 document and the paper list

steps.what: Number every passage in each paper
Read each paper in full; sort its ideas into groups; merge alike ideas into draft codes
steps.record: Candidate and draft codes, with their passages; ideas set aside, with reasons

steps.what: Decide each code: tick, work out, keep for reference, or drop
Check that each paper states its code
steps.label: we confirm

phases.name: Code the interviews
phases.containers: Each round codes 25 new interviews and recodes the earlier ones. What fits no code becomes an anomaly.
phases.out: A coded round, and the next version of the codebook

steps.what: Draw 25 new interviews at random; number every passage
steps.record: The round's sample and seed (round.json); Segments with fixed numbers

steps.what: Code the new interviews and recode earlier ones, blind
steps.record: The model's coding, every reason, and what the checks removed

steps.status: built; not yet used in a round

steps.what: Check the coding; compare old with new, and ours with the model's
steps.record: Definitions, rivals and types per story; Agreement reports (harness/codebook/reliability/)

steps.what: Group the anomalies; check each against the literature
steps.record: Anomaly log (harness/codebook/anomaly_log.json); Searches, verdicts and papers kept
